none: PAS CAM-D2BFFD: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy barbarous radiate copying a radiate of Tetricus I, c. AD 275-285
contea di ritrovamento: City of Peterborough (Inghilterra e Galles)

A copper-alloy barbarous radiate copying a radiate of Tetricus I, c. AD 275-285 (Reece period 14). Reverse legend is illegible. Reverse shows Sol running left, raising right hand and holding whip in left. Mint is uncertain, c. AD 275-285. Obverse legend reads [...]RICV. Obverse shows a radiate bust right. Die axis is 10 o'clock. Weight is 1.52g, diameter is 14.0mm, thickness is 1.7mm
